about.story: At Morning Star Fields, we keep things close to home, with eggs that are laid, collected, and packaged on our family-owned farm. Established in 2022, we have grown into one of Florida's most certified local farms by focusing on a system that works in harmony with the land and our hens. Through our BioCircular approach, resources are reused, waste is minimized, and every part of the farm has a purpose. It is a thoughtful, closed-loop way of producing eggs you can feel good about, from our farm to your table.
about.history: Established in 2022, Morning Star Fields began its journey as a groundbreaking hyper-sustainable agricultural venture on the outskirts of Vero Beach, Florida. Born from the remnants of a 276-acre orange grove, it swiftly embraced innovation to redefine farming practices.
about.mission: At Morning Star Fields, our mission is to revolutionize agriculture through modern engineering and ethical practices. We strive to produce the highest quality farm products while minimizing our environmental footprint and promoting animal welfare.
about.team: Made up of dedicated farmers, ranchers, and support staff who are passionate about what they do. We work hard every day to ensure that our animals are well-cared for and that our crops are healthy and abundant. We're proud to be a part of the local farming community.

faqs.a: We are a biocircular farm in Vero Beach. We grow food the way nature does it best, with care, reuse, and respect for the land.

Fresh eggs are our main focus today, but we're expanding to include 100% organic chicken manure fertilizer, hydroponic flowers, herbs, and seasonal farm products. Every part of our farm works together in a biocircular system designed to make the most of every resource.
It means nothing goes to waste if we can help it. What the farm produces helps the farm right back.

faqs.q: Do you use chemicals or antibiotics?
faqs.a: Nope. We keep things natural and simple. The old fashioned way works just fine.
Our eggs come from hens raised in state of the art facilities with certified humane care. They get fresh air, space to move, and cage free living. Happy hens, better eggs, that is the simple truth.

We are based in Vero Beach. Our eggs are laid, packed, and shipped within 48 hours. Right now we deliver B2B within about 250 miles across Florida, keeping it local so everything stays fresh and close to home.
We are not open to the public at this time. We are focused on keeping the farm running smoothly and producing the best quality eggs and products for our partners.

faqs.q: Is it only a chicken farm?
faqs.a: Not at all. We've got cows, goats, pigs, two dogs, a cat, and even a roaming alligator that is not part of the family but likes to hang around outside.
